steps.text: two workers can update the same draft revision. who wins?
choices I see: last write wins; reject stale revisions with compare-and-swap and no per-draft lock; or serialise writers with an advisory lock plus a revision check.
last-write-wins would quietly lose a paragraph.
advisory lock protects the transaction but we'd still need a version check after a crash, right?
I'd use compare-and-swap on the revision, no per-draft lock, and return a conflict to the loser.
same. the client can rebase and try again.
